# Design tokens (TK)

This is the short form. Before writing code in this area, read the full rules with reasons, bad/good examples and checks: `.ui-polish/rules/02-design-tokens.md`.

- **TK-01 No hard-coded colours outside the token file** (error). Component code and stylesheets never contain hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()` or `oklch()` literals. Colours are written once, as custom properties in the token file, and used everywhere else through `var(--token)` or a semantic utility (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`). Opacity variants derive from tokens (`bg-primary/10`, `color-mix()`), not from new literals.
- **TK-02 No Tailwind arbitrary values for spacing, type, radius or z-index** (warning). Do not write `p-[13px]`, `gap-[18px]`, `text-[15px]`, `leading-[1.35]`, `rounded-[10px]` or `z-[999]`. Use the scale step (`p-3`, `text-sm`, `rounded-md`, `z-(--z-modal)`). If the design needs a value the scale lacks, add a token and use it by name. Arbitrary values that reference a variable (`w-(--sidebar-width)`, `h-[calc(100dvh-var(--header-height))]`) are fine.
- **TK-03 Semantic colour utilities, not the raw palette** (warning). Do not style with Tailwind's default palette (`bg-blue-600`, `text-gray-500`, `border-slate-200`). Use role-based utilities backed by tokens: `bg-background`, `bg-card`, `bg-primary`, `text-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`, `ring-ring`, `bg-destructive`, `text-success`.
- **TK-04 Spacing values are on the 4px scale** (warning). In CSS, padding, margin and gap use the spacing scale: 0, 1px, 2px, then multiples of 4px (4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 80, 96), with 6, 10 and 14 allowed for dense controls. Prefer the token (`calc(var(--spacing) * 4)` or `var(--space-4)`) over the literal.
- **TK-05 A token file exists and is complete** (error). Before the first component, create one token file that defines, for light and dark: surface and text colours by role, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, success, warning, info (each with a `-foreground`), border, input, ring; a radius base; four elevation shadows; font families; a z-index scale; motion durations and easings; section spacing and container widths. Copy `recipes/react-tailwind-shadcn/tokens/tokens.css` and replace the values marked EXAMPLE with the ones in `design.md`.
- **TK-06 z-index comes from a scale** (warning). Never write `z-index: 9999` or any three-digit literal. Use the scale: `--z-sticky` 10, `--z-dropdown` 20, `--z-overlay` 30, `--z-modal` 40, `--z-popover` 50, `--z-toast` 60, `--z-tooltip` 70. Inside a component, small local values (1, 2) with `isolation: isolate` on the parent are fine.
- **TK-07 Name tokens by role, in two layers** (warning). Keep two layers. Primitive values (a neutral ramp, a brand ramp) may exist, but components only use semantic tokens named for their job: `--background`, `--card`, `--muted-foreground`, `--border`, `--destructive`. Never name a token after its value (`--blue`, `--gray-light`, `--shadow-big-purple`), and pair every surface token with the text colour that goes on it (`--primary` / `--primary-foreground`).
- **TK-08 Reuse the token; do not mint near-duplicates** (warning). Before adding a token, look for one that already carries the meaning. The set stays small: about 4 radii, 4 shadows, 3 durations, 2 easings, 8 font sizes. A new token needs a new role, not a slightly different number.
